# NEW 2026-11-18 1337 start S4 (events of the first two years, oe_s37_). Generated by gen_start_1337_events.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Debug counter: one event fired by this track's scheduler (guarded, r10 lesson 1).
oe_s37_count = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_s37 } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_s37 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_s37 add = 1 } }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scheduler
# BYZ scope, once, when event 2 fires (before the event, never in a preview): the revolt modifier on the BYZ-owned
# Albanian locations, the border pressure add on the march themes that hold them (D3, gen_round4_border.py).
oe_s37_alb_setup = {
    location:berat = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s37_alb_revolt months = 24 mode = replace } } }
    location:avlonya = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s37_alb_revolt months = 24 mode = replace } } }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_frontier = yes oe_s37_alb_holds = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_s37_tbd_add value = 25 months = 24 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tbd_pressure add = 25 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_tbd_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_ev_m } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_alb_fired value = var:oe_s37_ev_m } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_alb_ans } remove_variable = oe_s37_alb_ans }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_alb_skipped } remove_variable = oe_s37_alb_skipped }
}

# BYZ scope. Drops events that can no longer fire. Event 2 dropped: event 3 counts from now (oe_s37_alb_skipped).
# Event 2 fired but unanswered for 12 months: event 3 counts from now as well.
oe_s37_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_2 value = 2 } set_variable = oe_s37_alb_skipped set_variable = { name = oe_s37_alb_ans value = var:oe_s37_ev_m } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_12 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_lapse_14 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_st_14 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:oe_s37_ev_st_2 ?= 1
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_alb_ans }
            has_variable = oe_s37_alb_fired
            var:oe_s37_ev_m >= oe_s37_alb_stale
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_s37_alb_ans value = var:oe_s37_ev_m }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Picks at most one event this month: an event at its window end first, else one roll per open event.
oe_s37_ev_pick = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 11 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 6 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 12 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 13 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_due_14 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 14 } }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_12 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_12 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 12 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_13 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_13 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 13 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 0 oe_s37_open_14 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_ch_14 set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_pick value = 14 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 1 } oe_s37_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 11 } oe_s37_fire_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 2 } oe_s37_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 6 } oe_s37_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 12 } oe_s37_fire_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 5 } oe_s37_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 3 } oe_s37_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 13 } oe_s37_fire_13 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_pick = 14 } oe_s37_fire_14 = yes }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly while var oe_s37_ev_on is set. Month 1 stays empty.
oe_s37_ev_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_ev_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_m value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_m add = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_s37_ev_m >= 2 }
        oe_s37_ev_lapse = yes
        oe_s37_ev_pick = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_s37_ev_all_done = yes var:oe_s37_ev_m >= 36 } }
        remove_variable = oe_s37_ev_on
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- co-emperor (the author's start-patch steps)
# BYZ scope. Imperial Authority -10, prestige -15; John V becomes co-emperor (oe_byz_character_patch.txt 63-83).
oe_s37_crown_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority } change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	    add_prestige = -15
	    character:byz_john_v_palaiologos ?= {
	        if = {
	            limit = { is_alive = yes }
	            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_byz_select_as_second_empire_mod days = -1 mode = replace }
	            if = {
	                limit = { NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate } }
	                change_character_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
	            }
	            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_byz_co_emperor_display value = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos } }
	        }
	    }
	    set_variable = oe_s37_crowned
	}
}

    set_variable = oe_s37_ev_init
    set_variable = oe_s37_ev_on
